title: Cerebras CEO pushes back on AI doomsday warnings
script:
Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman says AI leaders should stop talking about doomsday scenarios.
He shared this message at the TechCrunch Disrupt conference in San Francisco.
Feldman claims that focusing on existential risks drowns out the benefits of AI.
He argues that the industry's obsession with worst-case outcomes is misguided.
The CEO instead wants to focus on building practical applications today.
Feldman believes we must look at the real utility AI provides right now.
Does this constant fear-mongering actually change how you use AI?

editor.one_line: Weak hook and repetitive visuals fail to meet premium news standards.
script_fixes: LINE 1: Replace 'AI leaders' with specific names or groups if mentioned in source, otherwise keep but tighten.
LINE 3: Replace 'benefits of AI' with a specific example of what he wants to focus on (e.g., 'scientific discovery' or 'enterprise efficiency').
